mentions.name: Playnite One-Click Mod Installer Add-on
mentions.description: Playnite add-on providing one-click installation of graphics mods and upscalers such as OptiScaler, ReShade, RenoDX, and Luma. It aims to detect games with Luma or RenoDX HDR mods and install them, and to add newer upscalers to games limited to FSR 2 or earlier or DLSS-only, with possible future support for automatically modding older games via Voodoo.
mentions.problem: Games with FSR 2 or earlier or DLSS-only upscaling lack newer upscalers, and HDR mods like Luma or RenoDX are not easy to install.
mentions.source_excerpt: now I'm working on an add-on for one-click installations of OptiScaler, ReShade, RenoDX, and Luma when it is possible
mentions.author: zexias
